sources.snippet: Aydin is a user-friendly, feature-rich, and fast image denoising tool that provides a number of self-supervised, auto-tuned, and unsupervised image denoising algorithms. Aydin handles from the get-go n-dimensional array-structured images with an arbitrary number of batch dimensions, channel dimensions, and typically up to 4 spatio-temporal dimensions.
